title: Node capabilities
description: Designed (docs/nodes.md 1 "Capabilities"), not implemented. What a node reports about its own hardware and programs, under the key `capabilities`. They advise the admin and the scheduler checks them at run time; they are never trusted for security, and a speed a node reports is never used (the hub measures speed itself). A station reports the station keys, a worker the worker keys, a node that is both reports both; every key is optional and a reader ignores one it does not know. Not to be confused with `caps`, the hub's list of capability strings in its state answer.

load1.description: The 1-minute load average (runnable tasks, not a percentage).

pct.description: CPU in use now, percent of all cores.

clips_free_gb.description: Free space on the volume that holds the clips, GiB.

gpu.title: GPU
gpu.description: From workers: the graphics card; null for none.

name.description: The card's name, as its driver gives it.

sdrs.description: From stations: one row per RTL-SDR dongle (today's App.sdr rows).

items.title: One dongle
items.description: One RTL-SDR dongle on the node.

serial.description: The dongle's serial as its EEPROM gives it.

tuner.description: The tuner chip or product name; "" when not read.

state.description: `ok` running its job; `out` opens but streams nothing; `held` by another program; `off` no job.

job.description: The job it is set to (a channel's label or a P25 system's job); "" for none.

group.description: The antenna group it belongs to; "" for none.

held_by_other_app.description: Another application on the machine holds this dongle through the shared claim files.

groups.description: From stations: the antenna groups (dongles locked to a set of jobs), as the station reports them today in `status.sdr.groups`.

channels.description: From stations: what each job in the node's channel set is doing now. The hub sends the wish; this is the node's answer, and failover is decided from it.

items.title: One channel's running state
items.description: One job (a conventional channel, a P25 system, paging) on this node.

job.description: The job's name, as in the role's channel set.

state.description: `running`; `waiting` no dongle for it; `out` a dongle that streams nothing or decodes nothing; `held` by another program; `shed` to a higher job of its antenna group; `not_in_set` runs here but is not in the node's set; `local` a person's override on the node. Anything but `running` counts as not covered.

whisper.title: Whisper
whisper.description: From stations and workers: the local speech-to-text model.

threads.description: CPU threads it decodes with, a count.

behind_live.description: Stations only: its queue is behind on live traffic now.

llm.description: From workers: the language model it serves; "" while it serves none (stopped, for example while the machine is used for a game).

adapter.title: Incident-source adapter
adapter.description: From stations: whether the private incident-source adapter could run here. Never a credential and never a value read from a source.

installed.description: The ids of the sources the installed adapter provides; [] when none is installed.

configured.description: Its credentials are in place on this node.

state.description: From workers: `online`, `gaming` (the machine is in use: no jobs) or `paused` (today's sttpool.STATES).

net.title: Network
net.description: From stations and workers: the link to the hub as the node measures it.

hub_rtt_ms.description: The round trip of a state post, milliseconds.

up_kbps.description: The upload rate measured on the outbox or the speech-to-text inputs, kilobits per second.

build.description: The git sha the node runs; "" when unknown. A station follows the hub's build; a worker reports its own.
